newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Dickson Concept postpones news conference.
newsitem.headline: Dickson Concept postpones news conference.

text.p: Wholesaler and retailer Dickson Concepts (International) Ltd said it had postponed a news conference at which it planned to announce updates on its international investments to Friday from Thursday.
A spokeswoman gave no reason for the change in schedule.
Analysts said the news conference may be related to U.S. luxury retailer Barney's Inc.
Dickson has been reviewing Barney's financial position in view of a possible investment proposal.
